_comment: Job 6163cd59d9043472 measured 36/40 ALL.js grids on the manifold engine with a 320s hang guard that now restarts on each streamed cell and a 290s model budget per cell, the pool at concurrency 4 and the five aggregates one at a time afterwards. No grid crashed the renderer. A cell whose model throws draws a skull-and-crossbones and the grid scores partial; after a wasm trap every later cell fails as not run. render-all.mjs --baseline diffs a run against failures[], cells included.
tree: main working tree, rsynced onto the CI base worktree by sci — no commit identifies the code that was measured
